dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, welcome back. Would you like to continue your Thwack 'n Smack Defense Bots experience?

choices.text: I'm really feeling this, let's keep going!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mmhmm! Looks like we've found ourselves a super fun way to practice arranging armies!

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: In that case, please get ready. Initiating Simulation Assist Mode — simulated combat will begin shortly.

choices.text: Can we run through that tutorial one more time?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Good idea! Paimon's already forgotten how to command those Thwack 'n Smack Defense Bots...

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: No problem. Please feel free to ask if there's anything else that requires clarification.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, this is such a big event, and it can't be easy running the Thwack 'n Smack Defense Bots booth. Are you sure you can handle it?

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Analyzing visitor traffic data and comparing to previous events...

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Analysis complete. Based on variables such as venue size and total footfall, the level of visitor traffic at this booth is comparable to Moon-Prayer Night.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Furthermore, on Moon-Prayer Night, I was also responsible for guiding the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop delegation and ensuring their orderly participation.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: In terms of complexity and level of control, the task of managing the Thwack 'n Smack Defense Bots booth fails to meet the threshold for a "highly difficult" classification.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That means you should be able to complete your assignment easy-peasy, right? Just so long as the visitors to your booth remember to behave themselves.

choices.text: I hope you don't get any unpleasant visitors.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Yes, it is a rather non-demanding task. And if all the visitors are polite, that will make me very happy.

choices.text: But if anyone does forget their manners, we'll be happy to give them a reminder for you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You've got this, Ineffa! We're going to keep looking around!

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Understood. Take care. Initiating Standby Mode...
